q1.explanationZh: theory 名词“理论；学说”，in theory“在理论上”；形容词 theoretical。

q2.explanationZh: therapy 名词“疗法，治疗”，physical therapy“物理疗法”；therapist“治疗专家”。

q3.explanationZh: there 副词“那儿”，there be 句型表示“有”。

q4.explanationZh: there + by = thereby“因此，由此”，常接现在分词表示结果。

q5.explanationZh: there + fore = therefore“因此；所以”，注意结尾的 e。

q6.explanationZh: these 是 this 的复数“这些”，后接复数名词。

q7.explanationZh: they 是主格代词“他们；她们；它们”，宾格 them，所有格 their。

q8.explanationZh: thick 形容词“厚的；浓的”，反义词 thin；动词 thicken“变厚”。

q9.explanationZh: thief 名词“小偷”，复数 thieves（f 变 v 加 -es）。

q10.explanationZh: thin 形容词“瘦的；薄的”，比较级 thinner、最高级 thinnest 要双写 n。

q11.explanationZh: thing 名词“东西；事情”，可数，复数 things。

q12.explanationZh: think 动词“想；认为”，过去式和过去分词都是 thought。

q13.explanationZh: think 加 -ing 构成名词 thinking“思考；思维”。

q14.explanationZh: thirst“口渴”加 -y 构成形容词 thirsty“口渴的”，feel thirsty“感到口渴”。

q16.explanationZh: thorough 形容词“彻底的”，注意拼写 th-o-r-ough，别和 through 混淆；副词 thoroughly。

q17.explanationZh: those 是 that 的复数“那些”，those who ...“那些……的人”。

q18.explanationZh: though 连词“虽然，尽管”，引导让步状语从句，主句前不再用 but。

q19.explanationZh: thought 作名词“思想；想法”，它也是 think 的过去式。

q20.explanationZh: thought 加 -ful 构成形容词 thoughtful“沉思的；考虑周到的”。

q21.explanationZh: thread 作名词“线”，作动词“穿（针、线）”，注意 -ea- 读 /e/。

q22.explanationZh: threat 名词“威胁”，动词是 threaten。

q23.explanationZh: threat 加 -en 构成动词 threaten“威胁”，threaten to do sth.“威胁要做某事”。

q24.explanationZh: throat 名词“喉咙”，clear one’s throat“清嗓子”。

q25.explanationZh: through“穿过”，表示从内部穿过；注意与 thorough、though 区分拼写。

q26.explanationZh: through + out = throughout“遍及；贯穿”，throughout the world“全世界”。

q27.explanationZh: throw 动词“扔，投”，过去式 threw，过去分词 thrown。

q28.explanationZh: thunder 名词“雷声”，动词“打雷”，It is thundering.“正在打雷。”

q29.explanationZh: thunder“雷”+ storm“暴风雨”= thunderstorm“雷暴”。

q30.explanationZh: thus 副词“这样；因而”，表示结果。

q32.explanationZh: clear one’s throat“清嗓子”，one’s 随主语变化，如 clear his throat。

q33.explanationZh: catch“抓住”+ a thief“一个小偷”。

q34.explanationZh: even though“即使，纵然”，语气比 though 更强。

q35.explanationZh: think much of sb./sth.“看重某人／某事”，常用于否定句，如 not think much of。

q37.explanationZh: think of“考虑；想起”，后接名词或动名词。

q38.explanationZh: think of ... as ... = consider ... as ... = regard ... as ...，都表示“把……看作……”，答出其中一个即可。

q39.explanationZh: think over“仔细考虑”，代词放中间：think it over。

accept: to lose the thread of one’s argument
to lose the thread of one's argument
lose the thread of one’s argument
lose the thread of one's argument

q40.explanationZh: thread 名词“线”，这里比喻“思路”，lose the thread of ...“失去……的条理”。

q41.explanationZh: throw ... away“扔掉；错过”，代词要放中间：throw it away。

q42.explanationZh: throw ... at ...“朝……扔（常带敌意）”，介词用 at。

q43.explanationZh: throw ... to ...“把……抛给……（让对方接住）”，介词用 to。

q44.explanationZh: within a stone’s throw“一箭之遥，近在咫尺”= quite near，throw 作名词“投掷的距离”。

q45.explanationZh: threaten to do sth.“威胁要做某事”，后接不定式。

q46.explanationZh: threaten sb. with sth.“用某事威胁某人”，介词用 with。

q47.explanationZh: Don’t 后接动词原形，throw rubbish“扔垃圾”。

q48.explanationZh: feel 是系动词，后接形容词 thirsty“口渴的”。

q49.explanationZh: “我原以为你可能会邀请她过来”，用 think 的过去式 thought。

q50.explanationZh: 主语 desert 是第三人称单数，一般现在时用 threatens“威胁”。

q51.explanationZh: be caught by a thunderstorm“遇上雷雨”，a 后接单数名词。

q52.explanationZh: physical therapy“理疗”，与 chemical one（化疗）相对。

q53.explanationZh: 从市场内部穿过用介词 through。

q54.explanationZh: 前后是因果关系，用副词 therefore“所以”。

q55.explanationZh: “卖掉农场”导致“有钱旅行”，用 thus“因而”表示结果。

q56.explanationZh: had been 后接形容词，thoughtful“沉思的”，与后文“突然开口”呼应。

q57.sampleAnswer: In theory, three things could happen.
references: In theory, three things could happen.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: in theory“在理论上”；“有三种可能性”可译为 three things could happen。

q58.sampleAnswer: He became a citizen, thereby gaining the right to vote.
references: He became a citizen, thereby gaining the right to vote.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: thereby“因此”后接现在分词 gaining 表示结果；“选举权”= the right to vote。

q59.sampleAnswer: You should always try to be thorough in whatever you do.
references: You should always try to be thorough in whatever you do.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: be thorough in ...“在……方面仔细周到”；whatever you do“无论你做什么”。

q60.sampleAnswer: Those who work hard will succeed in the end.
references: Those who work hard will succeed in the end.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: those who ...“那些……的人”，who 引导定语从句；“最终”= in the end。

q61.sampleAnswer: Though simple in form, the monument standing in the city centre serves as a historical witness, continually shaping our national spirit and inspiring future generations.
references: Though simple in form, the monument standing in the city centre serves as a historical witness, continually shaping our national spirit and inspiring future generations.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: Though simple in form 是省略的让步状语从句（主语相同省去 it is）；serve as“作为”；shaping、inspiring 是现在分词作伴随状语。

q62.sampleAnswer: There is growing evidence that physical exercise has a positive effect on children’s intellectual development and interest cultivation.
references: There is growing evidence that physical exercise has a positive effect on children’s intellectual development and interest cultivation.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: There is growing evidence that ...“越来越多的证据表明……”，that 引导同位语从句；have a positive effect on“对……有积极影响”。

q63.sampleAnswer: Please write and let me have your thoughts on the matter.
references: Please write and let me have your thoughts on the matter.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: thought 作可数名词“想法，意见”，your thoughts on the matter“你对此事的看法”。

q64.sampleAnswer: Who is to blame for this accident?
references: Who is to blame for this accident?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: be to blame for ...“应为……负责”；this accident“这次事故”。

q65.sampleAnswer: I thought you would go to Beijing with me by high-speed rail.
references: I thought you would go to Beijing with me by high-speed rail.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “以为”指过去的想法，用 think 的过去式 thought，从句用 would 表示过去将来。

q66.sampleAnswer: He spent too much time on some unimportant things, which led to the failure of the whole plan.
references: He spent too much time on some unimportant things, which led to the failure of the whole plan.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: spend time on sth.“在某事上花时间”；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事；lead to“导致”。
